overall_reason: A tiered token set (brand primitives such as --color-ivory-light under semantic and component tokens such as --button-background) drives colour, spacing and radius; the page's own components use 7 text colours, 5 radii and a spacing scale 97% on 4px, and the drift is retyped literals and a few missing references.

score.reason: T-VALUE-INVENTORY, T-SCALE-FIT and T-TOKEN-TIERS pass; T-HARDCODE finds literals equal to token values and undeclared references (TOK-006).

findings.evidence: Rules retype token values as literals: 280 spacing, 120 font-size, 112 colour and 89 radius declarations equal a declared token's value (declarations.literal_retypes_a_token_value), and radius declarations are 50% literal (96 of 191).
findings.before: Literal 8, 16 and 32px gaps and #141413 ink beside the tokens that hold them
findings.after: Rules reference the spacing, radius and colour tokens; literals stay in the token block
findings.why: A token change then misses every retyped copy, and the next designer cannot tell which values follow the brand.

findings.evidence: Rules reference tokens that no readable sheet declares and give no fallback: --type-body (8 uses), --ease-out-cc (8), --color-text (4), --type-display (3) (tokens.undeclared_references.without_fallback). Script or inline styles may declare them.
findings.before: var(--type-body) with no declaration and no fallback
findings.after: Declare --type-body, --type-display, --color-text and --ease-out-cc in the token file, or give each a fallback
findings.why: If no script sets them, those rules fall back to inherited values without warning.

findings.evidence: The z-index values are -1, 1, 2, 20, 100 and 101 (values.1440.ladder); 100 and 101 are one-offs, although 5 z-index tokens are declared (tokens.by_family.z_index).
findings.after: The nav and its popover reference the declared layer tokens
findings.why: Typed layers escalate by one each time a new overlay needs to sit on top.

strengths: Spacing sits on a 4px scale (share 0.972 against chance 0.3) and 98% of rendered spacing equals a token value.
Radii come from a named family (--br-4 to --br-32) and every rendered radius is on a token (on_token_share 1.0).
Component tokens (--button-background, --button-height) sit above brand primitives, so buttons change in one place.
Durations sit on a short scale (100, 150, 200, 250, 300ms) with 79% on a token.
not_investigated: inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles only
token source files behind the shipped CSS (Sass, JSON tokens, Figma variables): only the shipped CSS was read
states the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus): their values are not in the table
the dark and alternate themes (slate, ivory, pin) as rendered: the capture shows one scheme; the dark class redefines 12 tokens and the table cannot tell which sections use it
